review_mode: Agent source review, no independent reviewer or runtime ledger receipt

requirement_match.summary: Confirmed staff get mandatory QR/manual-copy/OTP onboarding; customers remain optional; complete six digits submits once.

security.summary: Authoritative active/unlocked staff roles required; server authorization, App Check and token MFA checks unchanged; transient secrets never persisted.

code_quality.summary: Shared per-account enrollment flight and context; source reviewed, 897 unit tests, lint and both builds passed.

failure_paths.summary: Revocation, logout, stale replies, competing enrollment, uncertain acceptance, expiry, QR/clipboard failures and unavailable authority exercised with synthetic transports.

error_handling.summary: Fresh input after invalid OTP; explicit readback before another uncertain enrollment; user-gesture reauthentication; recovery instead of endless CRM spinner.

production_readiness.summary: Assessment complete: NOT_DEPLOYED and live Google/Firebase NOT_TESTED; synthetic UI success is not provider acceptance.

trade_offs.summary: Staff onboarding is mandatory in the client; existing backend proof policy remains unchanged. SDK operations cannot be aborted; late UI replies are ignored and account flights serialize enrollment.

findings: Error focus could run while input remained disabled
Server metadata transitions needed authoritative role checks
fixes: Include metadata changes and require server-confirmed roles

findings: Ambiguous acceptance could permit duplicate enrollment
Underlying security status could remain stale
Eager QR payload and copy feedback movement
fixes: Lazy Security and reserved feedback line

findings: Cached initial authority could leave CRM waiting indefinitely
fixes: Unavailable state and explicit retry; fixtures and isolated unit environment corrected

findings: Optional page and mandatory popup could compete when staff rights arrived
fixes: Optional context gate and shared UID enrollment flight; browser regression and unit tests

residual_risks: Real Google popup, Identity Platform configuration, TOTP enrollment and fresh MFA JWT proof require live-provider acceptance.
Already running Firebase SDK enrollment cannot be aborted on logout; stale UI callbacks are ignored.
limitations: Repository intelligence DEGRADED: stale worktree indexes and unusable CocoIndex; bounded source/compiler/tests used.
Screen-reader software, non-Chromium browsers and legacy historical browser fixtures NOT_TESTED.
ai-agent-kit runtime CLI unavailable; task-local evidence records used.
Unrelated concurrent work preserved and excluded from reviewed implementation.
